propositions: The 800-LOC module-size soft cap has an escape hatch via an allowlist plus per-file ceilings that lets 12 over-cap modules persist and grow.
Each grandfathered module must be split along a real call-graph seam without creating files under 100 LOC, landed as its own Gerrit change.
Every split module must be removed from both the allowlist and ceilings files and its architecture.md remedy row.
The allowlist/ceilings mechanism and its sync contract test and shell gate branch must be deleted so no module can be exempted.
A hard gate must block changing the 800 limit through normal contribution, requiring an admin manual override.
CI must still fail any new file exceeding the absolute 800-LOC cap.
